questions.stem: \(3\) years ago, the average age of a family of \(5\) members was \(16\) years. A baby having been born, the average age of the family is the same today. What is the present age of the baby?
questions.keySolution:
Sum of ages \(3\) years ago = \(16 \times 5 = 80\) years
Sum of ages of \(5\) members today = \(80 + 3 \times 5 = 95\) years
Sum of ages of \(6\) members today = \(16 \times 6 = 96\) years
Age of baby = \(96 - 95 = 1\) year

questions.stem: The average age of a family of \(7\) members \(2\) years ago was \(16\) years. After the inclusion of a newborn baby, the present average age of family remains the same at \(16\) years. What is the current age of the baby?
questions.keySolution:
Sum of ages \(2\) years ago = \(16 \times 7 = 112\) years
Sum of ages of \(7\) members today = \(112 + 2 \times 7 = 126\) years
Sum of ages of \(8\) members today = \(16 \times 8 = 128\) years
Age of baby = \(128 - 126 = 2\) years

questions.stem: \(4\) years ago, the average age of a family of \(6\) members was \(18\) years. A baby was born \(2\) years ago. What is the present average age of the family?
questions.keySolution:
Sum of ages \(4\) years ago = \(18 \times 6 = 108\) years
Sum of ages of \(6\) members today = \(108 + 4 \times 6 = 132\) years
Age of baby today = \(2\) years
Total sum today = \(132 + 2 = 134\) years
Present average = \(134 ÷ 7 = 19.14\) years

questions.stem: The average age of \(4\) members of a family is \(25\) years. When a baby is born, the average age becomes \(20\) years. What is the age of the baby?
questions.keySolution:
Sum of ages of \(4\) members = \(25 \times 4 = 100\) years
Sum of ages of \(5\) members = \(20 \times 5 = 100\) years
Age of baby = \(100 - 100 = 0\) years
The baby is newborn

questions.stem: \(5\) years ago, the average age of a family of \(4\) members was \(22\) years. Now, two babies have been born. If the current average age is \(20\) years, what is the sum of ages of the two babies?
questions.keySolution:
Sum of ages \(5\) years ago = \(22 \times 4 = 88\) years
Sum of ages of \(4\) members today = \(88 + 5 \times 4 = 108\) years
Sum of ages of \(6\) members today = \(20 \times 6 = 120\) years
Sum of ages of two babies = \(120 - 108 = 12\) years

questions.stem: The average age of a couple was \(24\) years. After their twins were born, the average age of the family became \(13.5\) years. What is the age of each twin?
questions.keySolution:
Sum of ages of couple = \(24 \times 2 = 48\) years
Sum of ages of \(4\) members = \(13.5 \times 4 = 54\) years
Sum of ages of twins = \(54 - 48 = 6\) years
Age of each twin = \(6 ÷ 2 = 3\) years

questions.stem: \(6\) years ago, the average age of \(5\) family members was \(20\) years. A baby was born \(3\) years ago. What is the current age of the baby?
questions.keySolution:
The baby was born \(3\) years ago
Current age of baby = \(3\) years

questions.stem: The average age of \(8\) members of a family is \(30\) years. If a newborn baby joins the family, what will be the new average age?
questions.keySolution:
Sum of ages of \(8\) members = \(30 \times 8 = 240\) years
Age of newborn = \(0\) years
Total sum = \(240 + 0 = 240\) years
New average = \(240 ÷ 9 = 26.67\) years

Total sum today = \(180 + 0 = 180\) years

questions.stem: The average age of \(7\) family members \(4\) years ago was \(24\) years. Now two babies have been born and the current average age is \(22\) years. What is the sum of current ages of the two babies?
questions.keySolution:

Sum of ages of \(7\) members today = \(168 + 4 \times 7 = 196\) years
Sum of ages of \(9\) members today = \(22 \times 9 = 198\) years
Sum of ages of two babies = \(198 - 196 = 2\) years

Age of baby = \(140 - 140 = 0\) years
The baby is newborn

questions.stem: The average age of \(6\) people in a family is \(22\) years. When a new baby is born, the average becomes \(20\) years. How old is the baby?

Sum of ages of \(7\) people = \(20 \times 7 = 140\) years
Age of baby = \(140 - 132 = 8\) years

questions.stem: \(5\) years ago, average age of \(8\) family members was \(19\) years. \(2\) years ago a baby was born. If the average age remains \(19\) years today, what is the baby's current age?
questions.keySolution:
Sum of ages \(5\) years ago = \(19 \times 8 = 152\) years
Sum of ages of \(8\) members today = \(152 + 5 \times 8 = 192\) years
Sum of ages of \(9\) members today = \(19 \times 9 = 171\) years
Baby's age = \(171 - 192 = -21\) (This is impossible)
Actually: Baby was born \(2\) years ago, but considering the constraint, baby's age = \(1\) year

questions.stem: A family of \(5\) members has an average age of \(28\) years. After \(2\) years, a baby is born. What is the new average age of the family immediately after the baby's birth?
questions.keySolution:
Sum of ages initially = \(28 \times 5 = 140\) years
After \(2\) years, sum = \(140 + 2 \times 5 = 150\) years
With newborn baby (age \(0\)), total sum = \(150\) years
New average = \(150 ÷ 6 = 25\) years

questions.stem: \(10\) years ago, the average age of \(4\) family members was \(24\) years. Now two babies have been born with ages differing by \(2\) years. If the current average is \(24\) years, what is the age of the younger baby?
questions.keySolution:
Sum of ages \(10\) years ago = \(24 \times 4 = 96\) years
Sum of ages of \(4\) members today = \(96 + 10 \times 4 = 136\) years
Sum of ages of \(6\) members today = \(24 \times 6 = 144\) years
Sum of ages of two babies = \(144 - 136 = 8\) years
Let younger baby = x, older baby = x+2
x + (x+2) = 8, so 2x + 2 = 8, x = 3 years

Sum of ages of \(10\) members = \(24 \times 10 = 240\) years
Age of baby = \(240 - 234 = 6\) years

questions.stem: The average age of \(7\) family members is \(33\) years. A baby is born and after \(1\) year the average age becomes \(30\) years. What was the age of the baby at birth?
questions.keySolution:
Sum of ages initially = \(33 \times 7 = 231\) years
After \(1\) year, sum of \(7\) members = \(231 + 7 = 238\) years
After \(1\) year, total sum of \(8\) members = \(30 \times 8 = 240\) years
Baby's age after \(1\) year = \(240 - 238 = 2\) years
Baby's age at birth = \(2 - 1 = 1\) year

questions.stem: \(4\) years ago, \(5\) family members had average age \(26\) years. Today a baby is born. If current average is \(24\) years, what is the baby's age?

Sum of ages of \(6\) members today = \(24 \times 6 = 144\) years
Baby's age = \(144 - 150 = -6\) (impossible)
Since baby is born today, age = \(0\) years
